Notes for updating the guide

Use this page to see what still needs an answer and which drawings and photos the guide is built from.

What's still open

Now confirmed

All six drawing sheets are read, along with the press manual. Your labels and the manual settle the port names, Vent Port, Filtrate Port, tanks, level pipe, rod location and breather ring. Your close-ups settle the timer labels, drive, motors, overloads, gearboxes and vibrator wiring.

KA1 and KA10: partly answered

On the drawings, KA1 sits between wires 2 and 12 and feeds the press controls. KA10 sits between wires 2 and 61 and feeds the separator. Neither relay is on the rail or has a coil on any sheet, and the manual doesn't mention them. The KA11 and KA12 sockets are tagged wire 2 where the drawing says 61, so KA10 looks left out and bypassed. On your door photo, SA2's tags appear to read 12, 17 and 18, so wire 12 exists but its source is still unknown. With power locked out, an electrician can test continuity from wire 2 to wire 12. The demo assumes both circuits are closed. Ask the maker whether these relays had a safety job, and whether the loose relay in the bag belongs here.

Still my best reading

The two float jumpers, the job of each electrode rod, the maintenance valve, the box on the screen, the end housing, and the KT2 setting (30 minutes on the dial against 5 in the manual). Check the drive fault-lamp behavior against the ATV320 manual, because I inferred it from the terminals used.

Still missing

I have the press manual except for any pages the camera cut off, including part of the anchor bolt table. I have only one page and two drawings for the separator, so its screen slot size, flow rate, cleaning steps and end housing settings are unknown. Its motor gearbox plate, level rods and loose screw also remain open. No dosing pump or sludge pump details have come through yet.
